# hallpass_gateway_host_keys (Data Source)

The gateway's SSH host keys, for pinning in agents' `known_hosts` (agents must never trust the gateway on first use). During a host-key rotation both keys are listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pin the gateway in agents' known_hosts (never trust it on first use).
data "hallpass_gateway_host_keys" "gw" {
  host = "hallpass.example.com"
  port = 2222
}

resource "local_file" "known_hosts" {
  filename = "${path.module}/known_hosts"
  content  = data.hallpass_gateway_host_keys.gw.known_hosts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Gateway host name agents connect to (for `known_hosts`).
- `port` (Number) Gateway SSH port (for `known_hosts`, default 22).

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) Host keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `known_hosts` (String) `known_hosts` lines for `host` and `port` (empty without `host`).

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) Algorithm.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
- `state` (String) `active` or `staged` (during rotation).
